name: Off The 8 Café
notes: 5 photos, all legible printed menus. 1.jpg and 3.jpg are the current Off The 8 Café menu (two facing-page spreads) and 5.jpg is its weekly specials insert; merged as one menu, no duplicates. 2.jpg and 4.jpg show an older menu under the previous name 'Franco's Flapjack Family Restaurant' at a different suite address with different prices for mostly overlapping dishes — treated as superseded and excluded to avoid mixing stale pricing into the current listing. Beverages sections (coffee, tea, juice, shakes, sodas) skipped as drink items, not dishes.
